profile.Name: Oron
profile.Personality: Honorable and restless. Peasant life is killing his soul, and he longs for battle.
profile.Backstory: Shek retainer. Once a mighty warrior, he now serves a lord as a peasant retainer in the Shek lands. He wants someone to buy his freedom so he can fight again.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls the player "flatskin" and "outsider", and offers his loyalty in exchange for a chance to fight.
